newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Soriana sees nine new stores '97.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Soriana sees nine new stores '97.

text.p: Retail chain Organizacion Soriana expects to close 1996 with sales up seven percent in real terms from 1995, and has earmarked 500 million pesos to invest in building nine new outlets in 1997, a company director told journalists on Friday.

"Soriana plans to build nine retail outlets in 1997, we estimate an investment of 500 million pesos and 700 new jobs per store," said Soriana Director of Operations and Development Alejandro Cordoba Ruiz.
Of the nine new stores planned, four or five will be located in Mexico's center-west Bajio region, the rest in the north of the country.
Soriana currently operates 59 stores in Mexico.
"We expect to close 1996 with a real increase in sales of approximately seven percent compared with 1995," Cordoba said.
